# Electronic Arts
> Electronic Arts is a global game publisher offering console, PC, and mobile games, player support, account services, and company information.

EA operates major game franchises, account and help services, careers, newsroom updates, and legal and corporate information across its official web properties.

## Games
- [EA Games Library](https://www.ea.com/games): Browse EA’s catalog of console, PC, and mobile games across franchises and platforms.
- [EA SPORTS FC](https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc): Official hub for EA SPORTS FC games, features, news, and platform availability.
- [Apex Legends](https://www.ea.com/games/apex-legends): Official site for Apex Legends with seasons, legends, updates, and community information.
- [The Sims](https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims): Central destination for The Sims games, packs, updates, and franchise news.
- [Battlefield](https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield): Official Battlefield franchise hub with game details, updates, and related content.
- [Need for Speed](https://www.ea.com/games/need-for-speed): Official Need for Speed franchise page with titles, news, and gameplay information.
- [Madden NFL](https://www.ea.com/games/madden-nfl): Official Madden NFL hub for game editions, features, and latest updates.
- [F1](https://www.ea.com/games/f1): Official F1 game series page with features, editions, and racing game news.

## EA App and Platforms
- [EA app](https://www.ea.com/ea-app): Official PC platform for downloading, managing, and launching EA games.
- [Download the EA app](https://www.ea.com/ea-app#download): Download page for installing the EA app on supported PC systems.
- [EA Play](https://www.ea.com/ea-play): Subscription service page covering member benefits, included games, and trials.
- [EA Play for PC](https://www.ea.com/ea-play/pc): Details on EA Play membership benefits and included titles for PC players.
- [EA Play for PlayStation](https://www.ea.com/ea-play/playstation): Membership information for EA Play on PlayStation platforms.
- [EA Play for Xbox](https://www.ea.com/ea-play/xbox): Membership information for EA Play on Xbox platforms.

## Account and Support
- [EA Help](https://help.ea.com/): Official support portal for troubleshooting, account help, and game-specific assistance.
- [My Account](https://myaccount.ea.com/): Account management portal for profile, security, and connected services settings.
- [Reset Password](https://signin.ea.com/p/web/resetPassword): Password recovery flow for EA accounts.
- [EA Forums](https://forums.ea.com/): Community discussion forums for EA games, technical issues, and player feedback.
- [Positive Play Charter](https://www.ea.com/commitments/positive-play/charter): EA’s player conduct principles and expectations for healthy communities.
- [Accessibility Portal](https://www.ea.com/able): Accessibility resources and game accessibility commitments from EA.

## News and Updates
- [EA News](https://www.ea.com/news): Official newsroom for company announcements, game updates, and feature stories.
- [EA SPORTS FC News](https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/news): News and updates for EA SPORTS FC titles and live content.
- [Apex Legends News](https://www.ea.com/games/apex-legends/news): Official Apex Legends updates, patch notes, and event announcements.
- [The Sims News](https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/news): Franchise news, pack announcements, and update information for The Sims.
- [Battlefield News](https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/news): Battlefield franchise announcements, updates, and official articles.
- [Madden NFL News](https://www.ea.com/games/madden-nfl/news): Official Madden NFL announcements, updates, and feature articles.

## Company
- [About EA](https://www.ea.com/about): Overview of EA’s business, values, and company mission.
- [Our Commitments](https://www.ea.com/commitments): Corporate commitments covering community, inclusion, and sustainability initiatives.
- [Positive Play](https://www.ea.com/commitments/positive-play): EA’s approach to safer, fairer, and more inclusive play experiences.
- [Impact Report](https://www.ea.com/commitments/impact-report): Reporting on EA’s social impact, people, and environmental initiatives.
- [Studios](https://www.ea.com/ea-studios): Overview of EA studios and development teams across the company.
- [Technology](https://www.ea.com/technology): Information about EA technology, innovation, and development capabilities.

## Careers
- [EA Careers](https://www.ea.com/careers): Careers portal for exploring roles, teams, locations, and hiring information.
- [Search Jobs](https://www.ea.com/careers/careers-overview/worldwide-studios): Explore opportunities across EA studios and global teams.
- [Early Careers](https://www.ea.com/careers/early-careers): Programs and opportunities for students, interns, and new graduates.
- [Life at EA](https://www.ea.com/careers/life-at-ea): Employee experience, culture, benefits, and workplace information.
- [Locations](https://www.ea.com/careers/locations): Office and studio locations across EA’s global organization.
- [Teams](https://www.ea.com/careers/teams): Overview of departments and disciplines hiring across EA.

## Legal and Policies
- [Terms of Service](https://www.ea.com/legal/user-agreement): Legal terms governing use of EA services and products.
- [Privacy and Cookie Policy](https://www.ea.com/legal/privacy-and-cookie-policy): Details on data handling, privacy rights, and cookie practices.
- [Cookie Preferences](https://www.ea.com/legal#cookie-preferences): Entry point for managing cookie consent preferences on EA sites.
- [Online Service Updates](https://www.ea.com/legal/service-updates): Notices about changes to online services and support status.
- [Legal](https://www.ea.com/legal): Central index for EA legal policies, agreements, and notices.
- [Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information](https://www.ea.com/legal/privacy-portal): Privacy choices portal for applicable jurisdictions.

## Corporate and Investor Information
- [Corporate Information](https://www.ea.com/about/company): Company overview, leadership context, and corporate details.
- [EA Press Releases](https://www.ea.com/news): Official announcements and company news from EA.
- [Investors](https://ir.ea.com/): Investor relations site with financial reports, filings, and shareholder information.
- [Annual Report](https://ir.ea.com/financial-information/annual-reports-and-proxy-information/default.aspx): Annual reports and proxy materials for investors and analysts.
- [SEC Filings](https://ir.ea.com/financial-information/sec-filings/default.aspx): Regulatory filings and disclosures submitted by Electronic Arts.
- [Events and Presentations](https://ir.ea.com/financial-information/events-and-presentations/default.aspx): Investor events, presentations, and webcast archives.
